components.name: Tapered shaft/window band
components.function: Need tapered shaft/base/lantern seat, balcony window band and spiral cladding/ramp decision; source pearl/lilac/gold style retained. Shared shore rocks/dock/stairs/lights reused. Sparse coastal grasses and seabirds; beam effects, internal stairs and tide access remain proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated tapered shaft/window band matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
